Markets.title: Anthropic expected to tell investors it sees over $30 trillion in potential revenue, WSJ reports
Markets.summary: Anthropic reportedly plans to tell investors that its total addressable market exceeds $30 trillion in preparation for an upcoming IPO. The company aims to use this valuation to justify heavy infrastructure spending and support a projected 2028 revenue target of $200 billion.

Markets.title: Japanese bond funds see record inflows as rising yields attract global investors
Markets.summary: Rising yields on Japanese government bonds have driven record inflows into Japanese bond funds this year. European investors are primarily responsible for increasing these global allocations.

Markets.title: Lumino Industries raises Rs 207 crore from anchor investors; IPO opens on August 27
Markets.summary: Lumino Industries has raised Rs 206.99 crore from anchor investors ahead of its Rs 700 crore initial public offering. The public subscription period for the share sale, priced between Rs 78 and Rs 82 per share, runs from August 27 to August 31, 2026.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices Sensex and Nifty reversed morning losses to close higher on Tuesday amid sharp volatility. Healthcare and financial stocks led the gains, while the broader market breadth remained mixed and cautious.

Markets.title: Welspun Corp promoter group, CEO to sell up to Rs 1,417 crore stake via block deal
Markets.summary: Welspun Corp's promoter group and CEO Vipul Mathur plan to sell up to 63 lakh shares, representing a 2.4% stake, through a block deal worth Rs 1,417.5 crore. The planned share sale follows a sharp rally in the company's stock price.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Adani Enterprises, Dixon Tech among 4 stock recommendations for Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian equities rose as milder-than-expected US sanctions on Iran lowered crude oil prices and bond yields. Analysts recommend Adani Enterprises, HDFC AMC, Hyundai Motor India, and Dixon Technologies as bullish stock picks.

Geo-Political.title: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
Geo-Political.summary: China criticized new United States sanctions targeting Iran and its trading partners as illegal. The United States threatened to isolate any nations that continue conducting business with Tehran.

Geo-Political.title: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
Geo-Political.summary: US media reports that the CIA director traveled to Moscow for unannounced discussions. Flight tracking data verified that an American military aircraft flew from the United States to Russia through Latvia on Tuesday.

Geo-Political.title: Brain disease in dead NFL players 'higher than previously shown'
Geo-Political.summary: A recent study reveals that at least one in four former NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 suffered from a degenerative brain disease. Researchers note that the actual rate among deceased players is likely much higher.

Geo-Political.title: Tornado tears through French village, leaving dozens hurt and homes ravaged
Geo-Political.summary: A severe tornado struck the south-western French village of Pomas, damaging hundreds of homes. Fifteen people were hospitalized with injuries resulting from the storm.

Geo-Political.title: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania
Geo-Political.summary: Two unvaccinated people died of measles in Pennsylvania amid a nationwide decline in vaccination rates. Consequently, U.S. measles cases have reached their highest level since the virus was eliminated.

Geo-Political.title: European rights court orders Turkey to free imprisoned businessman
Geo-Political.summary: The European Court of Human Rights has ordered Turkey to release imprisoned philanthropist and activist Osman Kavala. Kavala has spent nearly a decade in jail on politically motivated charges.

Data & Insights.title: Piyush Goyal offers BIS exemptions to high-tech chipmakers, AI firms to boost ‘Make in India’
Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal has granted Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) exemptions to semiconductor and artificial intelligence companies to accelerate their operations in India. This decision addresses concerns raised by Japanese firms regarding delays caused by previous certification requirements.

Data & Insights.title: India plans 100 new ships to cut $75 billion foreign freight bill
Data & Insights.summary: India plans to add 100 new ships to reduce its $75 billion foreign freight bill. This expansion addresses a current cost disadvantage, as operating Indian-flagged vessels is 16-20% more expensive than operating foreign-flagged ships.

Data & Insights.title: India’s macro strength cushions global shocks as war, tariffs cloud outlook: RBI
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India stated that strong domestic economic momentum is protecting the country from international shocks like wars and tariffs. According to its August bulletin, high-frequency indicators show continued growth in both the manufacturing and services sectors.

Data & Insights.title: EMT: India secures top rank again in July among EM peers as stock market posts gains
Data & Insights.summary: India ranked first on Mint's Emerging Markets Tracker for July for the third consecutive month. This top ranking was driven by resilient economic performance and strong stock market inflows despite rising inflationary pressures.

Data & Insights.title: India leads South Asia’s growth, but China+1 gains remain uncertain: World Bank economist
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank economist Franziska Ohnsorge states that while India is driving South Asia's economic growth, its ability to capture China+1 manufacturing shifts remains uncertain. She notes that artificial intelligence holds greater potential than the China+1 strategy to serve as a major growth driver for India.

Data & Insights.title: Scott Bessent eying US Treasury cashpile, could use $1 trillion General Account for debt buybacks, says report
Data & Insights.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent plans to use the department's $1 trillion General Account to fund expanded buybacks of older, higher-yielding securities. This strategy, reported by CNBC citing senior officials, aims to manage the national debt more effectively.

India.title: 'August 25' Big Reveal Leaves Users Disappointed, Rs 8.5 Crore Scam Allegations Surface
India.summary: Social media users have accused a platform of running an Rs 8.5 crore scam following a disappointing "August 25" big reveal. The allegations claim that approximately 166,000 people deposited Rs 500 each.

India.title: Technical Fault In Mumbai Metro Station Lift Traps Passengers, All Rescued
India.summary: Passengers were trapped inside a glass lift at a Mumbai metro station due to a technical fault. Metro staff spotted the trapped individuals through the transparent walls and safely rescued them.

India.title: Chaos At House Panel Meet After Priyanka Gandhi Raises July 20 Police Action
India.summary: A parliamentary committee meeting became chaotic after Priyanka Gandhi raised the issue of a July 20 police lathi charge. Opposition and BJP MPs argued over whether the committee had jurisdiction, as minors were among the injured.

India.title: District Collectors Get Power To Grant Citizenship In 8 Regions Under CAA
India.summary: India's Ministry of Home Affairs has empowered District Collectors in eight regions to grant citizenship under the Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA). This policy change aims to simplify and accelerate the processing of citizenship applications for eligible migrants.

India.title: Delhi Records Wettest August Day In 2 Years, Several Areas Waterlogged
India.summary: Delhi experienced its wettest August day in two years, resulting in severe waterlogging across several areas. Weather stations across the city recorded heavy rainfall, ranging from 68.0 mm in Palam to 101.9 mm in Ayanagar.
